footnote_text: The transaction reported in this Form 4 is made pursuant to a Rule 10b5-1 trading plan adopted on August 29, 2024.

Represents Restricted Stock Units ("RSUs") that were fully vested as of the grant date. These RSUs represent awards received in lieu of 50% of the Reporting Person's cash bonus earned for the first half of the fiscal year ending January 31, 2027 under the Issuer's Senior Executive Cash Incentive Bonus Plan. The Reporting Person elected to convert such cash bonus into RSUs representing 115% of the earned cash bonus amount. The number of RSUs granted is based on a per share value of $10.42, the closing price of the Issuer's common stock on September 14, 2026.
The common stock was granted under the Seaport Entertainment Group Inc. 2024 Equity Incentive Plan, pursuant to the Seaport Entertainment Group Inc. Independent Director Compensation Program.
